geometry.language: hard-edged voxel geometry with clean axial cuboids
geometry.block_density: large contiguous surfaces, low contour noise
geometry.block_size_hierarchy: large primary volumes, medium contour steps, few small accents
geometry.proportions: compact adult game-scale silhouette; race proportions come from the profile and reference guide
geometry.texture: restrained low-frequency pixel colors, aligned texture blocks, few tiny accents
geometry.render: unlit-looking matte game model with enough even light to read depth, simple diffuse shading

frame.camera: orthographic, cardinal axis, fixed scale and target per reference pack, level horizon

background.description: plain neutral grey, no floor line, no scenery

frame.lighting: soft even studio lighting, no hard cast shadows or bloom

negative_prompt: photorealistic skin, rounded organic sculpting, painterly brushwork, plastic toy, fine noisy surface detail, busy gradients, excessive bevels, large anime eyes, cinematic rim lighting, bloom, cast shadows, scenery, text, watermark, collage, multiple figures, multi-view sheet, perspective distortion, cropped silhouette
